scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; standalone auxiliary arithmetic and numerical checks are finite, not an independent proof. No independently performed mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only half-integer frequency spacing, integer translation spacing, real Poisson windows of positive width and finite translation-column deletions. No best numerical frame bounds, no classification for arbitrary infinite deletion sets, and no general irregular-frequency theorem. An unindexed equivalent proof remains an originality risk.
title: Finite-column erasure robustness for Poisson Gabor frames at half-frequency sampling
